proves.claim: next offers an open dependent whose after-gate parent is submitted with a green gate at its head, and holds it back while that gate is queued, running or red.

store.io-board-next.after-gate-green-par.why: Without this test a dependent filed behind a gate stays hidden until its parent is verified, so a chain of slices builds one reviewed step at a time.

proves.claim: next still skips a dependent behind a plain --after parent that is only submitted, and one whose after-gate parent's green gate was recorded at another head.

store.io-board-next.plain-after-submitte.why: Without this test the early offer could widen to every submitted parent and offer work built on code nobody has gated.
